title: Pedestrian Deaths Rose 77% While Traffic Deaths Fell
hook: Pedestrian deaths rose 77% while overall traffic deaths fell.
closing: Safer roads for drivers have not made walking safer.
question: Do you feel safe near traffic?

segments.say: US traffic deaths fell to 40,990. The overall road toll improved for a second year.
Pedestrian deaths rose 77%. People on foot became the outlier while other traffic deaths grew far less.
Pedestrians made up 18% of traffic deaths. Falling totals still hide a growing danger for walkers.
